about: The wooden knob's blank at the workbench, stage necked (docs/gameplay/furniture_recipes_v1.md 4.1; written by tools/author-wooden-knob-actions.mjs): the part necked of the wooden_knob_work mesh (code only, no item). Points, bounds: item block units of the mesh as drawn (meshes/wooden_knob_work.aflmesh.json + (0.5, 0.458661, 0.5)); y along the blank from the tenon's end (foot) to the head. Scale 1.35: as the knife (0.42 px per cm), the 4 px fist a hand. center; foot, head (the ends); hold_foot, hold_head: the left palm on an end (2 px past it); pinch: the right palm on the +z face.
